newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian 39-day T-bonds sell at 9.75 pct.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian 39-day T-bonds sell at 9.75 pct.

text.p: Nigeria's Central Bank said on Tuesday it sold 1,250 million naira worth of 39-day treasury bonds at a weighted average rate of 9.75 percent.
Bids totalled 1,300 million naira and the true yield will be 9.852 percent.
Last sales were 8,652 million naira worth of 45-day treasury bonds at a weighted average rate of 9.69 percent.
The central bank also said that on the primary market, 91-day treasury bills worth 6,336 million naira were sold at a marginal rate of 10.0 percent and true yield of 10.25 percent.
It said the bids were worth 6,736 million.
